name: Hop Into 99 Nights in The Forest OWL!
desc:
Welcome to Hop Into 99 Nights in the Forest! 🌲✨

👟 Hop over walls, bounce your way through and see how far you can go! Each jump takes you closer to the mysterious Owl waiting at the top!  🦉

💨 Jump through his head at the end to reach the Winner’s Zone and show everyone your hops are unstoppable! 🏆

⚡ Can you make it all the way to the Owl or will you come back another time to complete the challenge? 🤔


Tags: 99 Nights In The Forest, The Deer, Owl, Jump into, enter, wall hop, wall jump, climb, forest escape, 99 nights, forest, escape
